long_biography.plain_text:
A UK joint venture brought Christopher Garbe into his family’s property group just before the global financial crisis. He had studied economics and business administration in Hamburg, completed an MBA in Sydney and worked in Australian shopping-centre development. Dealing with distressed banks gave him early responsibility during a difficult transition.

As an executive, Garbe concentrated on logistics and industrial property while forming long-term partnerships with institutional investors. The privately owned platform expanded across Europe and adopted a model combining development, operation and investment. He favours teams with enough autonomy to build new ventures without heavy bureaucracy.
